headline: Long side finding: our longs buy dips, but the typical up-mover is strength near its high, which no live setup buys; a near-HOD continuation long is now being planned.
bullets: Observer (6 sessions, descriptive): we caught 14% of 150 long movers and only 3 of 67 that start at 09:35; 42 longs bought after the top lost -23.2R (Generator -20.9R).
Caught movers were dip reversals (RSI ~23); missed movers sat near the high of day (RSI ~49) - a gap in our long book.
Five plans frozen and audited before any score: GATE2, SC2, SC1 (event-day long), CWT14SKIP (2 configs), C3FR; laggard-family bar set at the harder N 92.
Skeptic flagged short-sale restriction and halt fills on big gap-downs for SC1; amendments requested.
Nothing scored yet; 2-year data rebuild after 16:00 ET.
